record.destination: A human can scan every map decision in one deterministic, read-only store-wide ledger, filter it by time, actor, provenance, or map, and zoom from each row to the canonical ticket, map, and cited source records.

payload.body: Initial intent fixes the row core: decision one-liner, ticket and map, deciding actor, provenance, filters exemplified by --since 7d and --by agent, and zoom through ticket show or recall. Planning-partner 0.4.0 is the released predecessor; its archived PRD stays closed. The CLI remains deterministic and read-only, canonical truth stays in tickets, journal events, and observations, and the recall quoted-phrase hint is only a fold-in candidate.
